out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster about hand washing was not posted at the hand sink located in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: EHS provided a hand washing poster for compliance during the inspection.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: there were dishes and pans being washed at the high temperature dish machine, which was not properly registering at the appropriate sanitizing temperatures.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM had the food service worker rewash the dishes utilizing the 3 compartment sink set up.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: baked beans in the WIC 47F, potato salad in prep top cooler 43F, potato salad and coleslaw at cold wells 55F, 54F.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM was able to relocate the food items back into the freezer and WIC within the time parameters to get back to 41F.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: large, deep containers of baked beans in the WIC
violations.corrective_action: The large, deep containers of baked beans were relocated to the freezer to get to 41F. EHS educated the CFM on dividing into smaller batches and using the ice wand method for better cooling. Stupid Good BBQ (Inspection Date: 06/25/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: both prep top coolers
violations.corrective_action: CFM will need to obtain and place thermometers in each unit for proper monitoring of ambient air temperatures before the next regulatory inspection.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: large containers of sugar and flour
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will label the containers of sugar and flour for compliance moving forward.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the high temperature dish machine was not reaching the appropriate sanitizing temperatures. The thermal plate registered at 147F
violations.corrective_action: The technician came onsite during the inspection for repairs. The 3 compartment sink was set up for use.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Wash Temp for Hot Water Warewashing Machines
violations.observation: The wash water temperature of the hot water sanitizing warewashing machine is not meeting the manufacturer's specifications. The minimum temperature was 160F while the actual temperature was 133F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution in spray type warewashers that use hot water to sanitize may not be less than: 1) 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine, 2) 150F for a stationary rack, dual temperature machine, 3) 160F for a single tank, conveyor, dual temperature machine, or 4) 150F for a multitank, conveyor, multitemperature machine. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT WITH THE HIGH TEMP DISH MACHINE WAS NOT REACHING 160F AND NOT PROPERLY SANITIZING DISHES. PIC SET UP 3 VAT SINK TO WASH DISHES UNTIL DISH MACHINE IS FIXED. PIC ALSO CALLED MAINTENANCE FOR THE DISH MACHINE BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION AND MAINTENANCE WAS COMING SHORTLY TO FIX IT.
